reviews.author: Mia Derstine
reviews.text: Traveling to Scotland, and there comes a time when the next meal MUST be Asian noodles or I’ll die. I’m fairly picky about ramen so it’s always a gamble, but this place was great. Got the chicken ramen with a very mildly spiced miso broth. Broth was tasty, but not too rich - I literally finished the entire bowl. Noodles were really interesting, in a good way. They weren’t a classic alkaline springy ramen, BUT they had a nice al dente texture that almost reminded me of soba. Nothing breaks ramen like a soggy sad noodle, and I’m happy to report these noodles passed the test! Service was fast and friendly. Apps were good. And reading everyone’s sticky notes and doodles on the walls was really cute. I’d definitely go back!

My sons ramen came and it was missing the pork and I never got a drink to have with my food, not by choice. When we asked for containers to take the food home they didn't bring enough and we had to ask for one more for my sons ramen. We didnt get a bag, we were not offered so as we were carrying out 4 containers of food someone not in uniform asked us if we would like a bag. If this had been my first experience in a maki and ramen I would not hurry back. But within the last 7 days I have been to your aberdeen store, here everything is exceptional especially the staff and service. I have also visited your Leith store, which was good. We were told the visit today was below par because the staff were new!

My daughter ordered the chicken Laksa and complained that the chicken was compressed sliced chicken not good for value for £18.50. We complained to the manager. She said she had no idea whether the chicken came in prepacked or ready cooked. She said we would not have to pay. We would have refused anyway as we had one mouthful each. The Manager offered us complimentary cocktails or desserts we refused and she gave us £40 vouchers which we still haven't used. Considering they are just up from Waggamommas they have strong competition and honestly not a patch on Waggas they really need to to their game.

reviews.text: our first server didn’t set table for us and then once we sat down didn’t attend to us until flagged down 20 minutes later Thankfully, Amidu, saved the day by being very attentive, apologised and help fix the orders that had been written down wrong (chicken given to veggies etc) also on a more positive note, GREAT vegan black garlic tonkotsu ramen. best i’ve had.

reviews.author: Mia
reviews.text: The first server seated us to our table and took ages to come back and serve us. We had to ask her to take our order because we were waiting for over 20 minutes. She got our order completely wrong and we had the wrong ramen delivered and she also ordered us chicken gyozas instead of veggie (we are vegetarians). She also hadn’t set the table so once the food did arrive, we had to try and find cutlery/napkins ourselves. Luckily and thankfully, Amidu took over and he helped to rectify things. He was really kind and helpful; great customer service from him! The food tasted nice but maybe not be the best place for vegans and vegetarians as you may accidentally be given meat.

reviews.author: Mari K
reviews.text: Had lunch here a while ago and was excited because of the raving reviews. Honestly not sure how they got these as the foods was extremely mediocre. Just another influencer spot that has the looks but not the goods. Staff was super lovely but clearly understaffed and a little unsure of how to handle busy periods. London has to stop with these inauthentic, mediocre, money grabbing places and needs to go back to prioritising businesses with unique, original and passion led cuisine.

reviews.author: Marvin Anthony Edmead
reviews.text: This was a bit ‘meh’ to be completely honest. The squid starter was bland and uninteresting. The ramen was good but not good enough considering the range of other options. Sadly, the service was friendly but not attentive enough. We had higher expectations. Too high? Maybe.

reviews.author: manesh Patel
reviews.text: Went there nearly 2 weeks ago for a birthday. Used their 50% off food discount. Atmosphere was pretty good and so was the food. Service however was astonishingly poor on the day. Apparently some staff didn't turn up and even though the place wasn't busy, it was one staff member for the entire resturant. This meant food and service was significantly delayed and some luke warm food served. This isn't the fault of the staff memeber. However we also realised after paying and leaving the venue that the discount applied was incorrect and i have been over charged. Tried emailing and calling to get this resolved with proof of reciept. No answer. Please get in touch with me to resolve! Been nearly 2 weeks now and still unresolved.

reviews.author: Jasmine Patel
reviews.text: My partner and I were really excited to try this new ramen spot out, however we were disappointed with our experience. When ordering drinks, we were told they hadn't got any coke in stock and it just got worse from there really.. the ramen lacked flavour, the broth tasted powdery, the boiled egg was stone cold and the noodles were stiff. The whole dish tasted cheap - nothing authentic about it and nothing compared to the real thing in Japan. Sorry, I would not recommend this place!

reviews.author: Ibz Itec
reviews.text: Haram!!! I have booked a table because it looks amazing nice Decor etc but the place sell pork. So called them to say if there is contamination of pork and she said she cannot guarantee pork being cooked in the same pan. Please remove the Halal sign from your restaurant because that is not Halal when Pork is stored with the beef and chicken and then cocked and cut in the same knife. We need to avoid such thing. If you have halal sign then the whole process should be halal.

reviews.author: Mat
reviews.text: I've never had sushi with this much DRAMA!! I got the new omakase set at maki nori Soho and chef Teddy Lee brought out the theatrics with smoke, fire, dry ice, caviar bumps and even a huge dry aged salmon. Omakase means "I'll leave it up to you" so it's chef's choice based on ingredients and seasonality. The 6th Sep menu: 1. Akami Crudo 2. Scallop Crudo ⭐ 3. Salmon Nigiri 4. Sea bream nigiri 5. Smoked hamachi nigiri ⭐ 6. Wagyu nigiri ⭐ 7. Caviar tequila bump 8. Negitoro hand roll ⭐ 9. Spicy tuna hand roll 10. Eel and Foie Gras hand roll ⭐ 11. Miso soup 12. Cheese tart ❌ Highlights for me include the scallop crudo which paired really well with the sweet orange; the wagyu nigiri which was so tender and almost melted in the mouth and the eel foie gras hand roll (I've never had this before!) which was so unique and the way the buttery fois gras just melted was insane. Whilst it does have you wanting MORE, overall this is a fairly priced omakase experience, when you consider the lovely ambience, minimalist interiors and playful theatrical aspects.

reviews.author: RACE MAK
reviews.text: Really enjoyed my meal at Maki Nori in Soho. The handrolls were freshly made and the A5 Wagyu and Duck Foie Gras ones were definitely my favourites. The sashimi was fresh too, and I really liked the presentation of the sushi boat with dry ice. We also had the Hokkaido Cheese Tart for dessert, which was a nice way to finish the meal. Overall, a lovely place for a date night or special occasion. Would definitely come back!

The Chef's Ceviche and the Miso Aubergine hand roll were outstanding. Definitely coming back
